def _append_params(oauth_params, params):
    combined = list(params) + list(oauth_params)
    non_oauth = [(k, v) for k, v in combined if not k.startswith('oauth_')]
    oauth = [(k, v) for k, v in combined if k.startswith('oauth_')]
    return non_oauth + oauth


def prepare_form_encoded_body(oauth_params, body):
